Changed in the adapter pass: T1 owns its whole agent-transcripts/<id>/ directory (main file plus subagents/), so its bytes are 608 + 282 = 890, and the subagent is listed separately. Beta's project is null: the slug Users-fixture-work-beta-tool cannot be resolved from the fixture (no workspace.json, no absolute path in the transcript, and /Users/fixture does not exist on disk), so it is not guessed.
